limitations: No working physical Android device or emulator is available, so installation, launch, responsive rendering, PIN interaction, one-minute usage timer and restart persistence are NOT_RUN.

The baseline stores state in app-private SharedPreferences and uses a local BCrypt PIN. It does not claim production server authentication, multi-device synchronization or encrypted business data storage.
The APK is debug-signed and has no configured GITHUB_REPOSITORY because the local Git repository has no remote.
